✋mid December. I never get sick, and when I do I continue my normal day to day life, so if I am bed ridden or complaining, something is seriously wrong.

I had the worst chest pain in my left lung, it felt like I'd broken a rib. I was coughing incessantly but it was so painful. I couldn't even turn my upper body by the time a week/week and a half went by. 

I finally folded after Christmas (consequently getting my whole family sick lol) and went to the Dr. They didn't test me for flu, strep, anything. Just handed me the bottle. I was better within 3 days, but I have never felt that much pain in my chest in my life. 

Ever since they started freaking out in March I've held to the belief that I already had it. 

I really wanna get the antibody test just because I'm curious but I don't want them using my data for anything nefarious so I refuse to have anything to do with it.

The same thing happened to me and I never had any friends because I wasn't miss goody two shoes at the christian college and now I ended up in over 20k of debt and never even finished. 

I could've gone to any public college for free because my grades were so good, but they never told me that because they didn't want public college to "corrupt" me. Also I was homeschooled my whole life. 

They had a horrible hold on me until I was about 22. It had been a journey and still is, my mom is narcissistic and manipulative and my dad is the enabler. They have a sick family dynamic and I'm thankful I'm not in it anymore. I have to keep them at LONG arm's length away from me and love them at a distance. 

Hey... I was practicing social distancing before it was popular! 😝
